title: Scalable Gradient Descent on Large Datasets
tagline: Serial and OpenMP gradient descent on Purdue's Anvil cluster.
description: Linear-regression gradient descent in C++ over about 9.8 million points, run serially and with OpenMP from 1 to 128 threads on Purdue's Anvil HPC system and on Apple Silicon. Parallel and serial outputs match, and the speedup reaches about 6.7× at 16 cores, with diminishing returns beyond that.
highlights: Serial and OpenMP implementations with thread-safe reductions
Strong-scaling study from 1 to 128 threads
About 6.7× speedup at 16 cores on Anvil

title: Monte Carlo Brute-Force Optimizer
tagline: Parallel brute-force optimization with MPI and OpenMP.
description: Parallel brute-force search for the optimum of a 2D function using MPI and OpenMP on the Anvil HPC cluster, with SLURM job scripts and Python plotting. Coursework for DSC 520, High Performance Scientific Computing.
highlights: Hybrid MPI and OpenMP parallelism
SLURM scripts for the Anvil cluster

title: COVID-19 X-Ray Classification: GPU Performance Study
tagline: How GPU configuration affects CNN training speed and accuracy.
description: A comparative study of training a TensorFlow/Keras CNN on COVID-19 chest X-rays under different GPU configurations, tracking training time, memory use, throughput, and test-set accuracy, precision and recall.
highlights: Configurable GPU, batch size and learning rate per run
Timing and GPU-utilization logs per configuration
Side-by-side convergence animation

title: Tripsy: AI Travel Assistant with RAG
tagline: Conversational trip planning with retrieval and a live map.
description: A FastAPI backend that answers travel questions with retrieval-augmented generation over a Milvus vector store (SentenceTransformers embeddings), and a Next.js frontend with a Leaflet map and OpenStreetMap geocoding. Runs with Docker Compose.
highlights: RAG over Milvus with a fallback answer path
Contextual memory across a conversation
Leaflet map with Nominatim geocoding

title: CLAD-PV: Cybersecurity and Load-Aware Dispatch for Photovoltaics
tagline: Secure control and monitoring for solar inverter networks.
description: A secure control and monitoring system for photovoltaic infrastructure: a guarded Modbus/TCP publisher and monitor, an authenticated curtailment API, spoofed-frame attack simulation, rule-based anomaly alerts on voltage, frequency and power, and signed audit logs. An OpenDSS feeder simulation supplies physics features such as net injection, power factor and ramp rate.
highlights: Authenticated curtailment control API
Spoofed Modbus frames to test the defenses
Signed, tamper-evident audit logs

title: Global Catalog API: Multi-Region Product Catalog
tagline: FastAPI on DynamoDB Global Tables, managed with Terraform.
description: A multi-region product catalog and inventory service on FastAPI and DynamoDB Global Tables, with Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure including a Lambda stream processor, simulated cross-region conflict resolution, and Docker packaging. A k6 load test recorded a p95 latency of about 50 ms on product reads and writes, with no failed requests.
highlights: DynamoDB Global Tables replication across AWS regions
Last-write-wins conflict simulation with an explain endpoint
k6 load test: p95 about 50 ms, 0% failed requests

title: Customer Churn Prediction Platform
tagline: An end-to-end churn pipeline from Delta Lake to a REST API.
description: Generates a synthetic subscription dataset, ingests and preprocesses it with PySpark and Delta Lake, trains an LSTM and XGBoost ensemble, and serves predictions from a FastAPI endpoint in Docker.
highlights: Delta Lake ingestion and PySpark preprocessing
LSTM and XGBoost ensemble
Dockerized prediction API

title: Aether: A Conversational Wellness Companion
tagline: Emotionally aware chat on Hugging Face Transformers.
description: A web chat companion for self-reflection: a FastAPI backend running a Hugging Face Transformers language model with prompts tuned for an empathetic tone, and a static frontend on GitHub Pages. The backend runs locally, and it is not a medical tool.
highlights: Prompting for an empathetic, non-robotic tone
Local backend, so conversations stay on the machine

title: Global Airports Dashboard
tagline: An interactive map and charts of the world's airports.
description: An interactive dashboard of global airport locations and types: a Leaflet map on OpenStreetMap tiles, a searchable list, a details panel, and a D3 distribution chart by category or continent, with filters and a light and dark theme.
highlights: Linked map, list and details panel
Click-through D3 distribution chart
Deployed on GitHub Pages

title: NASA Logs Billing Dashboard
tagline: Credit-based billing over NASA HTTP log events.
description: Parses NASA HTTP access logs into billable events and prices them in credits (one per request plus one per KB served), with a FastAPI service for usage and invoices, a Plotly dashboard, and Docker packaging.
highlights: Log parser that emits billing events
Usage and invoice API by date range
Plotly usage dashboard

title: LocalMapReduce
tagline: A local MapReduce simulation on LMDB.
description: An educational, single-process MapReduce simulation in Python that writes intermediate key-value pairs to an LMDB store, with a command-line interface to run jobs and clear the store.
highlights: Map and reduce phases over an LMDB key-value store
Command-line run and clear
